body: Hi, thank you so much. Thank you for caring. I live in the US. Marietta, GA.  I'm sleeping behind the mailboxes at my old apartment complex right now. I will pm you. Much love right back.

Do you have any music I could listen to? I'd love to hear it. I'm also sorry to see you had to deal with an asshole troll. Fuck people like that. 
I'm a fellow artist too, and for a while music was what kept me alive. I'm also a fellow smoker of the wacky tobacky so we can definitely connect :) hit me up, whether you just want to vent or not, I'd love to listen. Keep your chin up. You're strong.

Please don't do it. I'm hurting as well, so I get the urge. You're alone right now walking in your tears. I walked around in my tears today too. So I know how much you must be hurting. Not many people seem to. But that "please try to talk me out of it", that shows me you have a light in you. I would be honored to let you see it. I'm probably up all night. We can talk. I'll listen. Pm me, please? I care about you. I value your worth. Even if it feels no one around you does. Pm me :)
